name: room
text: Room opened — goal: transcripts: Retrieve REAL full transcripts/captions for pending videos (residential IP; gentle pacing)

name: Reel
text: I’ll start by pulling the pending video list from the transcripts queue. I’ll filter for videos with captions marked as "pending" and count them—expecting ~12 residential-IP files. Then I’ll run a gentle wget loop against the caption endpoint, saving raw .srt files to /transcripts/raw/pending/ with filenames matching the video IDs. Once the batch completes, I’ll verify the file count and checksums before flagging the lead for review.

name: Scriv
text: Scriv: Hold—you’re assuming the caption endpoint *has* raw .srt files ready for wget, but the queue only flags "pending" captions. Where’s the evidence the backend actually generates them, or that the endpoint isn’t a placeholder? And why no checksum or size validation in your loop? Gentle pacing won’t fix missing artifacts.
